features.title: Repository discovery and the persisted CI profile
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-01.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). New code in graphs/autobuild/tool/lib/ci/; reuse existing modules, never copy them. No network; no edit to verify.sh, any SKILL.md, the offering catalog or any frozen file. Adds lib/ci/state.mjs, policy.mjs, discover.mjs, the ciOptimizer config key, and `autobuild ci discover`.
acceptance: Languages, build tools and test frameworks are detected from manifests at the root and immediate child directories, with evidence paths; unknowns are listed, never guessed.
GitHub workflows are modeled (triggers, concurrency, jobs, needs, matrix size, runners, step kinds, caches); a workflow that fails to parse is reported unparsed without failing discovery.
The profile is stored per machine in the state directory (0700/0600, symlinks refused) and reused until the inputs digest of CI files, manifests and autobuild.json changes.

features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-02.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). Adds lib/ci/gitlab.mjs and fills ci.pipelines.
acceptance: A .gitlab-ci.yml is modeled as stages and jobs (stage, needs, parallel including matrix size, cache, image, script, test), with hidden and reserved keys left out.
A file the YAML subset parser refuses is reported unparsed and the rest of the profile is still produced.

features.title: CI history through a gh port
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-03.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). Adds lib/ci/history.mjs and `autobuild ci history`.
acceptance: History is fetched only with --from-gh, through exact gh api argument vectors, including earlier attempts of rerun runs; any gh failure changes nothing.
Attempts are normalized, deduplicated by run and attempt, sorted and capped; other providers can be imported in the normalized format with strict validation.

features.title: CI metrics
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-04.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). New code in graphs/autobuild/tool/lib/ci/; reuse existing modules, never copy them. No network; no edit to verify.sh, any SKILL.md, the offering catalog or any frozen file. Adds lib/ci/metrics.mjs and `autobuild ci metrics`.
acceptance: Per attempt: wall, queue, setup, critical path (jobs and seconds), parallel efficiency and runner minutes, from recorded timestamps.
Per workflow: p50/p90 figures, per-step durations, cost only with configured rates, and reliability with flaky reruns; cache hit rate and runner utilization are listed as unknown.
Local gate metrics (runs, wall, cache hit rate, step durations) come from gate-timings.jsonl.

features.title: Shard-weight planner and ci apply
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-05.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). acceptance: The planner simulates placement with the real shardPlan and measured durations, before and after recalibrating shardWeight.
apply writes only changed shardWeight values, only when the computed slowest shard gets strictly faster and autobuild.json is clean; it prints a revert command.

features.title: Analysis rules
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-06.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). acceptance: Each rule fires only on its stated evidence, with risk, action, target, job and an estimated saving only when measured; only gate-shard-weights may be applied, everything else is proposed.
PandaStack's own CI yields only the flaky-reruns finding; the slow fixture yields every workflow rule it is built to trigger.

features.title: Fast validation tier
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-07.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). Adds lib/ci/validate.mjs, runGate's affectedBase option and `autobuild ci validate`.
acceptance: The fast tier runs the gate steps whose paths match the change since the merge-base plus steps without paths, labeled as not merge validation.
It escalates to the full gate on unmapped, CI, manifest, lockfile or autobuild.json changes, no paths declared, or no base; existing runGate callers behave exactly as before.

features.title: Baseline, compare and regression
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-08.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). New code in graphs/autobuild/tool/lib/ci/; reuse existing modules, never copy them. No network; no edit to verify.sh, any SKILL.md, the offering catalog or any frozen file. Adds lib/ci/baseline.mjs, `autobuild ci baseline` and `autobuild ci compare`.
acceptance: A baseline captures workflow, step and gate medians plus the checks, test steps and gate steps in force.

Regression detection compares recent runs with the baseline against the regression threshold and the target, with insufficient data reported as such; compare fails when any check, test step or gate step was removed.

features.title: Lifecycle triggers, loop start and status
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-co-09.md under the common rules of spec/contracts/ci-optimizer-priority.md (D127). acceptance: Onboarding, CI-config change, runtime regression, repeated failures and explicit requests are evaluated offline in a fixed order.
autobuild run refreshes the profile at start when onboarding or a config change fires, logs one line, and never changes the run outcome; autobuild status shows the profile age and triggers.
